data.name: BF Biosciences Limited
data.description: BF Biosciences Limited ("BFBL", "Company", or the "Issuer") was incorporated as an unlisted public limited company under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (now Companies Act, 2017) in 2006, and operates within the pharmaceutical industry. BFBL is a 80%:20% joint venture between Ferozsons Laboratories Limited and the Bagó Group of Argentina. The Company's core operations involve the import, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of pharmaceutical products.
